issues.description: Sample rate not validated against allowed STTAudioFormat values
issues.detail: The constructor casts `f"pcm_{sample_rate}"` to STTAudioFormat without validating the rate is in the supported set (8000/16000/22050/24000/44100/48000). Passing e.g. sample_rate=11025 produces an invalid `pcm_11025` format string that will only fail server-side, with a confusing error.

issues.description: APIConnectionError raised inside recv_task callback may not propagate cleanly
issues.detail: `_process_stream_event` raises APIConnectionError on ElevenLabs error frames, but this runs inside recv_task wrapped by `log_exceptions`. The exception may be swallowed/logged rather than terminating the stream and triggering reconnect, leaving the session stuck after auth_error or quota_exceeded.

issues.description: API key leak risk via base_url and missing scheme validation
issues.detail: `base_url` is user-controllable and only str-replaced for scheme. A misconfigured `base_url` (e.g. http://attacker/) will send the `xi-api-key` header to an arbitrary host over plaintext. Consider validating that base_url uses https/wss, or at minimum warning on non-TLS schemes.

issues.description: Reconnect loop never actually reconnects on transient failures
issues.detail: The outer `while True` only re-enters when `_reconnect_event` is set, but nothing in the class sets it. If recv_task raises APIStatusError on unexpected close, tasks_group surfaces the exception and the `break` path is skipped, but no retry occurs either. The reconnect scaffolding is effectively dead code.

issues.description: Trailing comma in single-element Literal is unusual
issues.detail: `STTModels = Literal["scribe_v2_realtime",]` has an awkward trailing comma. While syntactically valid, it reads like a typo and should either drop the comma or be formatted to clearly indicate room for future models.

The handler only logs at debug level and does not emit any SpeechEvent. If the API sends this message type instead of `committed_transcript` under some conditions, transcripts will be silently dropped. Either route it through the same emission path or document why it is intentionally ignored.

review.summary: The PR adds a clean STTv2 streaming implementation following the established Deepgram/Cartesia patterns. Main concerns are around robustness: unvalidated sample_rate casting to a Literal type, ambiguous reconnect semantics (the `_reconnect_event` is never triggered internally), and error frames raising exceptions inside recv_task that may not propagate as intended. A minor base_url scheme-validation gap creates a small API key exposure risk. No P0 blockers, but the error/reconnect flow should be tightened before merge.
